header: The pads' plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, played with its tools/gamepad_probe.js as the preload
(--preload): four stand-in pads plugged in at the launcher, before Start Game, as a player's pads are there when the
game starts. Their ids are Chrome's on Windows for an Xbox pad over XInput (two), a DualSense and a Bluetooth Xbox pad,
whose ids are longer than SDL keeps and which SDL renames, so the page has to find each by its place in
navigator.getGamepads(). Each pad plays a port of its own in the order they were plugged in (RECOMPINPUT_PADS_IN_ORDER),
the keyboard port 1 beside the first, so at the title NuSystem counts four controllers (nuContNum, 0x8010C2D0), each
with a pak in (nuContStatus, 0x800FEDC8: type 5, CONT_CARD_ON). The keyboard takes FOUR players at the main menu,
and at character select each port picks a golfer with its own controller, in port order: the game makes whoever
picks first 1P, and so on, and plays each player from the controller that picked. Stroke play on Toad Highlands,
then each player tees off in turn with their own controller (A three times: start, power, impact). The game buzzes
the pad of the player whose turn comes and of the one swinging, so every pad has rumbled once all four have
swung (padRumbles(): plays per pad, in the order they were plugged in): each port's Rumble Pak was found and its
rumble reached that port's own pad.
